# JT49 in NanoQL

These files are an unmodified copy of the JT49 AY-3-8910-compatible sound core
by Jose Tejada (Jotego): <https://github.com/jotego/jt49>.

NanoQL uses JT49 for its optional QSound hardware expansion. JT49 is licensed
under GPL-3.0-or-later; its license is retained in `LICENSE` and its source file
headers are unchanged.
